notes: 44 hours is an industry-research-based model assumption, not a government statistic or guaranteed loss.
The 1.0% emotional/cognitive allowance is a research-informed modeling assumption. No cited study measures exactly 1.0% annual workplace loss from zero cellular coverage.
Adding direct and cognitive hours assumes distinct effects. Their overlap has not been measured, so the combined estimate may overstate loss if effects overlap.
Employee exposure is assumed proportional to the share of building space without usable cellular service. Actual employee locations and time spent may differ.
Hourly wage equals annual average pay divided by 2,080. This is a wage-only approximation; QCEW includes both full-time and part-time workers.
Main-shift workforce proxies are not measured annual FTEs. Applying annual hours to these counts is a modeling assumption. No shift multiplier is used.
The five-year estimate assumes current workforce, coverage conditions, productivity assumptions, and wage rates remain unchanged. No inflation, wage growth, discounting or compounding is applied.
